text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see Dugan, the Nuka-Cola addict of the Blades.
source_text: You see Dugan, the Nuka-Cola addict of the Blades.

text: 你看见杜根，利刃帮核子可乐的上瘾者。
source_text: 你看见杜根，利刃帮核子可乐的上瘾者。

text: You see a very tall thin man with glasses. He has a bottle of Nuka-Cola clutched in his hand.
source_text: You see a very tall thin man with glasses. He has a bottle of Nuka-Cola clutched in his hand.

text: 你看见一个很高的戴着眼镜的男子。他手里拿着一瓶核子可乐。
source_text: 你看见一个很高的戴着眼镜的男子。他手里拿着一瓶核子可乐。

text: Yes?
source_text: Yes?

text: 有事吗？
source_text: 有事吗？

text: I'm just looking around, thanks.
source_text: I'm just looking around, thanks.

text: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。
source_text: 我只是随便看看，谢谢。

text: What do you do around here?
source_text: What do you do around here?

text: 你在这儿做什么？
source_text: 你在这儿做什么？

text: What's with the Nuka-Cola?
source_text: What's with the Nuka-Cola?

text: 核子可乐是什么？
source_text: 核子可乐是什么？

text: Whose in charge around here?
source_text: Whose in charge around here?

text: 这地方被谁控制？
source_text: 这地方被谁控制？

text: Ah, never mind.
source_text: Ah, never mind.

text: 啊，没关系。
source_text: 啊，没关系。

text: Dah, Cola, good?
source_text: Dah, Cola, good?

text: 啊，可乐，不错？
source_text: 啊，可乐，不错？

text: Well, then stop wasting my time.
source_text: Well, then stop wasting my time.

text: 好吧，不要浪费我的时间了。
source_text: 好吧，不要浪费我的时间了。

text: I pontificate on life a lot, and help the Blades understand the true meaning of Nuka-Cola.
source_text: I pontificate on life a lot, and help the Blades understand the true meaning of Nuka-Cola.

text: 我花费了生命中的大部分时间，帮助利刃帮成员明白了核子可乐的真正意义。
source_text: 我花费了生命中的大部分时间，帮助利刃帮成员明白了核子可乐的真正意义。

text: What's so good about Nuka-Cola?
source_text: What's so good about Nuka-Cola?

text: 核子可乐有什么好？
source_text: 核子可乐有什么好？

text: Is that all? That doesn't seem to help anyone that much.
source_text: Is that all? That doesn't seem to help anyone that much.

text: 就这样吗？这看起来并不能帮到人们什么。
source_text: 就这样吗？这看起来并不能帮到人们什么。

text: How much of that stuff do you drink?
source_text: How much of that stuff do you drink?

text: 你能喝多少那玩意？
source_text: 你能喝多少那玩意？

text: Can I ask you something else?
source_text: Can I ask you something else?

text: 我能再问你几个问题吗？
source_text: 我能再问你几个问题吗？

text: Ah, ok.  I'll be seeing you.
source_text: Ah, ok.  I'll be seeing you.

text: 啊，好吧，我们会再见面的。
source_text: 啊，好吧，我们会再见面的。

text: It is the stuff of life . . . Well actually, if I don't drink it on an hourly basis I get a splitting headache.
source_text: It is the stuff of life . . . Well actually, if I don't drink it on an hourly basis I get a splitting headache.

text: 这是生命之源……说实在的，如果我一个小时不喝这个东西我就会头痛的要命。
source_text: 这是生命之源……说实在的，如果我一个小时不喝这个东西我就会头痛的要命。

text: So? 【Dugan raises his eyebrows at you.】
source_text: So? 【Dugan raises his eyebrows at you.】

text: 那么？【杜根对你扬起眉毛】
source_text: 那么？【杜根对你扬起眉毛】

text: About 5 litres a day.
source_text: About 5 litres a day.

text: 大概一天5升。
source_text: 大概一天5升。

text: Razor's the woman you'll want to talk to.
source_text: Razor's the woman you'll want to talk to.

text: 你该和剃刀那女人谈谈。
source_text: 你该和剃刀那女人谈谈。

text: I am the dumbest person I've ever met - well, besides you. Get out of here!
source_text: I am the dumbest person I've ever met - well, besides you. Get out of here!

text: 我是这世上最蠢的人——当然，除了你。滚出去！
source_text: 我是这世上最蠢的人——当然，除了你。滚出去！

text: I need another Nuka-Cola!
source_text: I need another Nuka-Cola!

text: 我需要另一瓶核子可乐！
source_text: 我需要另一瓶核子可乐！

text: Where'd my hair go!
source_text: Where'd my hair go!

text: 我的头发去哪了？
source_text: 我的头发去哪了？

text: Carbonated Water, Caramel Color, Aspartame, Phosphoric Acid, Potassium Benzoate 】To Protect Taste】, Natural Flavors, Citric Acid, Caffeine
source_text: Carbonated Water, Caramel Color, Aspartame, Phosphoric Acid, Potassium Benzoate 】To Protect Taste】, Natural Flavors, Citric Acid, Caffeine

text: 苏打水、焦糖、柠檬酸精、磷酸、苯甲酸钾【为了保持口感】，天然口味、柠檬酸、咖啡因。
source_text: 苏打水、焦糖、柠檬酸精、磷酸、苯甲酸钾【为了保持口感】，天然口味、柠檬酸、咖啡因。

text: Too bad we ran out of Diet.
source_text: Too bad we ran out of Diet.

text: 太糟了我们几乎没有食欲。
source_text: 太糟了我们几乎没有食欲。

text: Where'd those short women go?
source_text: Where'd those short women go?

text: 这些小女人要去哪？
source_text: 这些小女人要去哪？
